hook: Push-ups chest pain or wrist pain? Fix your form instantly!
caption:
Push-ups correct form telusukondi! Many people mistake arm position and end up with shoulder pain. Correct technique enti ante, elbows ni body ki daggaraga, 45-degree angle lo pettali. Appude chest muscles ki proper load velthundi.

Save this reel for your next chest workout and share with your gym partner! 💪✨

#PushUps #FitnessTelugu #WorkoutTips #GymForm #ChestWorkout #FitnessIndia #HealthyLiving #TeluguFitness
poster_caption:
Most people do push-ups entirely wrong, leading to shoulder impingement and poor muscle growth. 🛑

Here is how to fix your mechanics:
• Fix your elbow angle to protect your rotator cuff
• Stack your wrists and engage your palms
• Lock your core and squeeze your glutes

📌 Save this guide for your next upper body workout!

#FitnessTips #PushUpForm #WorkoutScience #StrengthTraining #FitnessMechanics #UpperBodyWorkout #HealthyJoints #GymTips
